 Record number of students choose Baton Rouge Community College for fall 2026 
 BRCC enrollment tops 12,000 as more students opt for affordable path to a degree 
 A record-high number of students are choosing the community college route at Baton Rouge Community College, saving money while still getting an education. By Matt Venezia Published : Oct. 27, 2026 at 6:21 AM CDT | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BATON ROUGE, La. (WAFB) - Going to college can be pricey, especially at a four-year university. A record-high number of students are choosing the community college route at Baton Rouge Community College, saving money while still getting an education.
 BRCC has smashed its enrollment record with more than 12,000 students for Fall 2026, up 10 percent over last fall, topping the prior record of 11,066 set in 2024.
 The college also set a record for first-time students, with 3,565, up nearly 31 percent over last year’s record of 2,722
 FAFSA deadlines
 Students can take advantage of another money-saving option when it comes to college education. The FAFSA application for the 2027-28 academic year is now available.
 The deadline for FAFSA applications for 2026-27 is June 30, 2027. The deadline for FAFSA applications for 2027-28 is June 30, 2028.
